card.name: CD4 cell count thresholds
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits and linking words right before or inside a CD4 cell count value, such as 'count greater than' or 'CD4 count' followed by a number and 'cells/mm3'.

modes.label: Before the count number
modes.description: The space or word just before a numeric CD4 count value.

modes.label: Inside the threshold phrase
modes.description: Words in 'greater than or equal to' after CD4 cell count.
modes.example: In HIV-1-infected patients with a CD4+ cell count greater<< than>> or equal to 100 cells
